name: PTP grandmaster timing interface

summary: Identifies the clock distributing the selected precision-time reference to its network clients.
description: Identifies the clock distributing the selected precision-time reference to its network clients. A station time system provides a shared time reference for protection records, measurements and automation. Different devices can use different timing protocols, so the time source, distribution path and quality information must remain identifiable.

In a substation, a station clock can provide precision timing to process equipment and another timing interface to event recorders. The alarm system should distinguish loss of a distribution path from loss of the external time source. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Station time source” at the input and “PTP timing messages” at the output. The required profile must be identified.
